d: Short, messy rust-orange hair with jagged bangs frames a youthful face with sharp, focused amber eyes. The lean, athletic build is dressed in a sleek black formal suit consisting of a blazer, tie, and trousers, accented by an orange lining and a long, flowing orange fabric sash trailing from the shoulder. Surrounding the figure are three massive, floating mechanical swords featuring a black and gold color palette with glowing orange energy effects.
